A few days ago I posted about this new app: http://archive.is/lgWjY Now that I installed it, here are my impressions.

Like the article says, Your news is an aggregator that offer you clips from different sources. Its got a pretty diverse list and even includes news agency like Reuters and AP. Of what I saw, the most popular one seems to be NBC.

You are supposed to be able to opt out of sources you don't want to see; unfortunately, the option does not work right now, at least for me, only getting a message to refresh the page without the list being ever accessible. It should be a simple fix with a patch, but its still unfortunate that I could not test it.

The quality of the videos is what you expect of news web site; they are ok but some seems to be sub-par HD.

The app does not offer original content; all you see is clips that you can find elsewhere. It does offer you a quick way to get them all in the same place.

The interface is classic Xbox videos app; you get your list of tabs on top and big preview windows on bottom to select your clip. A note: when you open the app it start the first clip automatically, making it more important to be able to remove sources you don't trust.

The app offer more than news. you can watch clips from diverse subjects such as : entertainment, sports, technology geekdom, you can even opt in a few other subjects. That option is working right now unlike the choose your source one.

It does what is advertised without giving you anything that makes it a go to app. Still if you don't have cable and are too lazy to open a computer or a tablet, it will give you a quick glance of what news sources think are relevant for the day.

Final verdict : Ok....I guess, but they better fix the opting out of sources quick; I want to be able to remove NBC and CNN as soon as possible.
